verbose.description: Enable verbose output (equivalent to lsscsi -v). Shows additional device details such as vendor/model revision and transport attributes.

describe_types.description: Show human-readable device type descriptions (e.g., 'disk' instead of '0').

show_hba.description: Include Host Bus Adapter (HBA) information in the listing (equivalent to -H).

show_transport.description: Include transport-specific details (e.g., SATA vs. SAS) in output (equivalent to -T).

numeric.description: Use numeric identifiers only (skip symbolic names like /dev/sda).

filter_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to filter which SCSI devices to display. Patterns match against the device's SCSI address (e.g., '0:0:*' for first host/channel).

items.description: A glob pattern (supports * and ? wildcards) matching device SCSI addresses (host:channel:id:lun).

lsscsi_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass directly to the lsscsi binary when invoked (e.g., '--scsi_only', '--nodev').

prefer_multipath.description: When multipath devices are detected, prefer showing /dev/mapper/* names instead of /dev/sd* device nodes.

transport_include.description: List of transport types to include (all others excluded). Valid transports: 'fibre_channel', 'sas', 'sata', 'scsi', 'usb', 'nvme', 'ide', 'ieee1394'.

transport_exclude.description: List of transport types to exclude (others included).

sysfs_path.description: Root path of the sysfs filesystem. Override only in non-standard environments (e.g., chroot, containers).

procfs_path.description: Root path of the proc filesystem. Required for device topology and host info.

timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for reading from sysfs/procfs. Set to 0 for no timeout.

debug.description: Enable debug logging to stderr for troubleshooting.
